overview_description.description: UnitX is a deep tech company that automates safety & security monitoring at industrial sites. Vizard, our patent-pending AI platform, leverages sensor data & video analytics to equip HSE & Security managers with real-time actionable insights. It detects life-threatening hazards such as worker falls, heat stress, etc., identifies and tracks workers, monitors restricted zones, and more. We help enhance worker safety, minimize incident risks and reduce operational costs while adhering to the highest levels of responsible AI and ethics. UnitX is an ISO certified company recognized by SDAIA & NVIDIA.
